Use the identity $\sin^2\theta = 1 - \cos^2\theta$ to write the equation purely in terms of $\cos\theta$:
$$8(1 - \cos^2\theta) + 6\cos\theta + 1 = 0$$
$$8 - 8\cos^2\theta + 6\cos\theta + 1 = 0 \implies 8\cos^2\theta - 6\cos\theta - 9 = 0$$

Factorise the quadratic equation in terms of $\cos\theta$:
$$(4\cos\theta + 3)(2\cos\theta - 3) = 0$$

Find the obtuse angle $\theta$ in the interval $0^\circ < \theta < 180^\circ$:
$$\theta = \cos^{-1}(-0.75) \approx 138.6^\circ$$
